rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being accountable or having duties, including a duty-bearing position.

example.english: They are responsible for looking after the elderly.
example.traditional: 佢哋有責任照顧老人家。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jau5 zaak3 jam6 ziu3 gu3 lou5 jan4 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is dependable and can be trusted to handle things properly.

example.english: This person is very responsible; just leave it to them.
example.traditional: 呢個人做事好穩陣，交畀佢處理就得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 zou6 si6 hou2 wan2 zan6 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 cyu2 lei5 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “responsible” emphasizes conscientiousness and a strong sense of duty rather than simple reliability.

example.english: They have always been responsible and always keep their promises.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都好有責任感，答應咗人嘅事一定做到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gam2 daap3 jing3 zo2 jan4 ge3 si6 jat1 ding6 zou6 dou2
